已创建 PIR #3
pim>

segments.caption: Contacts preserve text and leading zeroes

已创建 PIR #4

segments.output:
search type = task && deadline < 2027-01-01 && !description contains "cancelled"

segments.caption: Quoted multiword search
segments.output:
